headline.statement: 76 of 150 investigator questions (50.7%) cannot be answered on the KSP schema as supplied, at any level of interface sophistication, because they need a person identity that spans FIRs. The schema has none. That is the gap SUTRA fills, measured from the question side rather than from the column side.

answerable_today.meaning: The parameterised console at /ask answers this now, with no new engine work and no language model.

needs_language_layer.meaning: Answerable against the schema plus the resolved table, but not through the console as built. Needs either a new parameterised question or a natural language layer, which is NOT BUILT.

impossible_on_raw_schema.meaning: Cannot be answered by any interface over the KSP schema as supplied, because it needs a person identity that spans FIRs and no such column exists. SUTRA constructs that identity, which is what moves these questions from impossible to answerable.

accuracy.why: Answering these from free text needs a natural language layer. It is NOT BUILT, no language model runs anywhere in this system, and there is nothing to run the set through. The deck claimed 74 per cent correct. That figure has no measurement behind it and is not repeated here.

kannada.why_not_all: Kannada is given where the question is one an officer would ask aloud at a station counter. The analyst phrasings are left in English, because a forced translation of an analyst's sentence is not a Kannada question. Interface chrome is translated separately, see ADR 023.

SQL present and contains a SELECT

tables list includes the resolved table when the SQL reads one

questions.question: How many FIRs were registered in this district last year?
questions.question_kn: ಕಳೆದ ವರ್ಷ ಈ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಎಫ್ಐಆರ್ ದಾಖಲಾಗಿವೆ?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS fir_count
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN District d ON d.DistrictID = cm.DistrictID
WHERE d.DistrictName = :district
  AND cm.CrimeRegisteredDate >= :from_date
  AND cm.CrimeRegisteredDate <  :to_date;

questions.question: Which people appear as accused in both of these two districts?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಎರಡೂ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಆರೋಪಿಯಾಗಿ ಕಾಣಿಸಿಕೊಂಡವರು ಯಾರು?
questions.sql:
SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cm.CaseMasterID) AS cases
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
JOIN District d    ON d.DistrictID    = cm.DistrictID
GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.DistrictName = :district_a THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN d.DistrictName = :district_b THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY cases DESC;

questions.question: How many accused persons have offended in more than one district?
questions.question_kn: ಒಂದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅಪರಾಧ ಎಸಗಿದ ಆರೋಪಿಗಳು ಎಷ್ಟು ಮಂದಿ?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS travelling_offenders
FROM (
  SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID
  FROM resolved_identity ri
  JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
  GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cm.DistrictID) > 1
) t;

questions.question: Which pairs of districts share the most offenders between them?
questions.sql:
SELECT da.DistrictName AS district_a,
       db.DistrictName AS district_b,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.ResolvedIdentityID) AS shared_offenders
FROM resolved_identity a
JOIN CaseMaster ca ON ca.CaseMasterID = a.CaseMasterID
JOIN resolved_identity b ON b.ResolvedIdentityID = a.ResolvedIdentityID
JOIN CaseMaster cb ON cb.CaseMasterID = b.CaseMasterID
JOIN District da ON da.DistrictID = ca.DistrictID
JOIN District db ON db.DistrictID = cb.DistrictID
WHERE ca.DistrictID < cb.DistrictID
GROUP BY da.DistrictName, db.DistrictName
ORDER BY shared_offenders DESC
LIMIT 20;

questions.question: For this accused, list every district they have been booked in.
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಆರೋಪಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಯಾವ ಯಾವ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಕರಣ ದಾಖಲಾಗಿದೆ?
questions.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT d.DistrictName
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
JOIN District d    ON d.DistrictID    = cm.DistrictID
WHERE ri.ResolvedIdentityID = :identity
ORDER BY d.DistrictName;

questions.question: Which offenders moved from one district to another and never came back?
questions.sql:
WITH span AS (
  SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID AS pid,
         MIN(cm.CrimeRegisteredDate) AS first_seen,
         MAX(cm.CrimeRegisteredDate) AS last_seen
  FROM resolved_identity ri
  JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
  GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
)
SELECT s.pid, fc.DistrictID AS from_district, lc.DistrictID AS to_district
FROM span s
JOIN resolved_identity rf ON rf.ResolvedIdentityID = s.pid
JOIN CaseMaster fc ON fc.CaseMasterID = rf.CaseMasterID
                  AND fc.CrimeRegisteredDate = s.first_seen
JOIN resolved_identity rl ON rl.ResolvedIdentityID = s.pid
JOIN CaseMaster lc ON lc.CaseMasterID = rl.CaseMasterID
                  AND lc.CrimeRegisteredDate = s.last_seen
WHERE fc.DistrictID <> lc.DistrictID
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM resolved_identity rx
    JOIN CaseMaster cx ON cx.CaseMasterID = rx.CaseMasterID
    WHERE rx.ResolvedIdentityID = s.pid
      AND cx.DistrictID = fc.DistrictID
      AND cx.CrimeRegisteredDate > s.first_seen
  );

questions.question: List every district with the number of police stations in it.
questions.question_kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಪೊಲೀಸ್ ಠಾಣೆಗಳಿವೆ?
questions.sql:
SELECT d.DistrictName, COUNT(u.UnitID) AS stations
FROM District d
LEFT JOIN Unit u    ON u.DistrictID  = d.DistrictID
JOIN UnitType ut    ON ut.UnitTypeID = u.UnitTypeID
WHERE ut.UnitTypeName = 'Police Station'
GROUP BY d.DistrictName
ORDER BY stations DESC;

questions.question: How many cases in this district involve an accused whose home district is elsewhere?
questions.sql:
WITH home AS (
  SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID AS pid, cm.DistrictID,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
                            ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rk
  FROM resolved_identity ri
  JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
  GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID, cm.DistrictID
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cm.CaseMasterID) AS outsider_cases
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN resolved_identity ri ON ri.CaseMasterID = cm.CaseMasterID
JOIN home h ON h.pid = ri.ResolvedIdentityID AND h.rk = 1
WHERE cm.DistrictID = :district_id
  AND h.DistrictID <> :district_id;

questions.question: Show the ten offenders active across the most districts.
questions.sql:
SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cm.DistrictID) AS districts,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cm.CaseMasterID) AS cases
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
ORDER BY districts DESC, cases DESC
LIMIT 10;

questions.question: Do offenders who cross districts commit graver offences than those who stay put?
questions.sql:
WITH reach AS (
  SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID AS pid,
         COUNT(DISTINCT cm.DistrictID) AS districts
  FROM resolved_identity ri
  JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
  GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
)
SELECT CASE WHEN r.districts > 1 THEN 'travelling' ELSE 'local' END AS band,
       g.GravityName, COUNT(*) AS cases
FROM reach r
JOIN resolved_identity ri ON ri.ResolvedIdentityID = r.pid
JOIN CaseMaster cm      ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
JOIN GravityOffence g   ON g.GravityOffenceID = cm.GravityOffenceID
GROUP BY band, g.GravityName
ORDER BY band, cases DESC;

questions.question: Which district registered the most cases this year?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಅತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪ್ರಕರಣ ದಾಖಲಾದ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.sql:
SELECT d.DistrictName, COUNT(*) AS cases
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN District d ON d.DistrictID = cm.DistrictID
WHERE cm.CrimeRegisteredDate >= :from_date
GROUP BY d.DistrictName
ORDER BY cases DESC
LIMIT 1;

questions.question: For this identity, in what order did the districts appear over time?
questions.sql:
SELECT cm.CrimeRegisteredDate, d.DistrictName, cm.CrimeNo
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
JOIN District d    ON d.DistrictID    = cm.DistrictID
WHERE ri.ResolvedIdentityID = :identity
ORDER BY cm.CrimeRegisteredDate;

questions.question: Which offenders appear in three or more districts inside a twelve month window?
questions.sql:
SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cm.DistrictID) AS districts,
       MIN(cm.CrimeRegisteredDate) AS window_start,
       MAX(cm.CrimeRegisteredDate) AS window_end
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cm.DistrictID) >= 3
   AND julianday(MAX(cm.CrimeRegisteredDate))
     - julianday(MIN(cm.CrimeRegisteredDate)) <= 365
ORDER BY districts DESC;

questions.question: How many cases were registered at each station in this district?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ಪ್ರತಿ ಠಾಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಪ್ರಕರಣ ದಾಖಲಾಗಿವೆ?
questions.sql:
SELECT u.UnitName, COUNT(*) AS cases
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN Unit u ON u.UnitID = cm.UnitID
WHERE cm.DistrictID = :district_id
GROUP BY u.UnitName
ORDER BY cases DESC;

questions.question: What share of all offenders is responsible for cases in more than one district?
questions.sql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN districts > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS share,
       SUM(CASE WHEN districts > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS travelling,
       COUNT(*) AS all_offenders
FROM (
  SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID,
         COUNT(DISTINCT cm.DistrictID) AS districts
  FROM resolved_identity ri
  JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
  GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
) t;

questions.question: Who are the repeat offenders at this station?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಠಾಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪದೇ ಪದೇ ಬರುವ ಅಪರಾಧಿಗಳು ಯಾರು?
questions.sql:
SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID, COUNT(DISTINCT cm.CaseMasterID) AS cases
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
JOIN Unit u        ON u.UnitID        = cm.UnitID
WHERE u.UnitName = :station
GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cm.CaseMasterID) >= :minimum
ORDER BY cases DESC;

questions.question: How many accused rows does this station hold?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಠಾಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಆರೋಪಿ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳಿವೆ?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS accused_rows
FROM Accused a
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = a.CaseMasterID
JOIN Unit u        ON u.UnitID        = cm.UnitID
WHERE u.UnitName = :station;

questions.question: How many distinct people do this station's accused rows actually represent?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಠಾಣೆಯ ಆರೋಪಿ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳು ನಿಜವಾಗಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಮಂದಿ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳು?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ri.ResolvedIdentityID) AS people,
       COUNT(*) AS rows_held
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
JOIN Unit u        ON u.UnitID        = cm.UnitID
WHERE u.UnitName = :station;

questions.question: Which offenders came back to the same station within ninety days?
questions.sql:
SELECT a.ResolvedIdentityID, ca.UnitID,
       ca.CrimeRegisteredDate AS first_case,
       cb.CrimeRegisteredDate AS return_case
FROM resolved_identity a
JOIN CaseMaster ca ON ca.CaseMasterID = a.CaseMasterID
JOIN resolved_identity b ON b.ResolvedIdentityID = a.ResolvedIdentityID
JOIN CaseMaster cb ON cb.CaseMasterID = b.CaseMasterID
WHERE ca.UnitID = cb.UnitID
  AND cb.CrimeRegisteredDate > ca.CrimeRegisteredDate
  AND julianday(cb.CrimeRegisteredDate)
    - julianday(ca.CrimeRegisteredDate) <= 90;

questions.question: Which station has the highest ratio of accused rows to actual people?
questions.sql:
SELECT u.UnitName,
       COUNT(*) AS rows_held,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ri.ResolvedIdentityID) AS people,
       COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ri.ResolvedIdentityID) AS inflation
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
JOIN Unit u        ON u.UnitID        = cm.UnitID
GROUP BY u.UnitName
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY inflation DESC;

questions.question: List the accused at this station with three or more cases anywhere in the state.
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಠಾಣೆಯ ಆರೋಪಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ರಾಜ್ಯಾದ್ಯಂತ ಮೂರು ಅಥವಾ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪ್ರಕರಣ ಇರುವವರು ಯಾರು?
questions.sql:
SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID, COUNT(DISTINCT cm.CaseMasterID) AS total_cases
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
WHERE ri.ResolvedIdentityID IN (
  SELECT r2.ResolvedIdentityID
  FROM resolved_identity r2
  JOIN CaseMaster c2 ON c2.CaseMasterID = r2.CaseMasterID
  JOIN Unit u        ON u.UnitID        = c2.UnitID
  WHERE u.UnitName = :station
)
GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cm.CaseMasterID) >= 3
ORDER BY total_cases DESC;

questions.question: How many cases at this station are still under investigation?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಠಾಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಪ್ರಕರಣಗಳು ಇನ್ನೂ ತನಿಖೆಯಲ್ಲಿವೆ?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_cases
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN Unit u ON u.UnitID = cm.UnitID
WHERE u.UnitName = :station
  AND cm.CaseStatus = 'Undetected';

questions.question: For each station, how many of its offenders also appear at another station?
questions.sql:
SELECT u.UnitName,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ri.ResolvedIdentityID) AS shared_offenders
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
JOIN Unit u        ON u.UnitID        = cm.UnitID
WHERE ri.ResolvedIdentityID IN (
  SELECT r2.ResolvedIdentityID
  FROM resolved_identity r2
  JOIN CaseMaster c2 ON c2.CaseMasterID = r2.CaseMasterID
  GROUP BY r2.ResolvedIdentityID
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c2.UnitID) > 1
)
GROUP BY u.UnitName
ORDER BY shared_offenders DESC;

questions.question: Which offenders at this station have been active for more than two years?
questions.sql:
SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID,
       MIN(cm.CrimeRegisteredDate) AS first_case,
       MAX(cm.CrimeRegisteredDate) AS last_case
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
HAVING julianday(MAX(cm.CrimeRegisteredDate))
     - julianday(MIN(cm.CrimeRegisteredDate)) > 730
ORDER BY first_case;

questions.question: How many accused at this station are recorded as absconding?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಠಾಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಆರೋಪಿಗಳು ತಲೆಮರೆಸಿಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS absconding
FROM Accused a
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = a.CaseMasterID
JOIN Unit u        ON u.UnitID        = cm.UnitID
WHERE u.UnitName = :station
  AND a.AccusedType = 'Absconding';

questions.question: Rank stations by the number of offenders with three or more cases.
questions.sql:
WITH repeat_offenders AS (
  SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID AS pid
  FROM resolved_identity ri
  GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ri.CaseMasterID) >= 3
)
SELECT u.UnitName, COUNT(DISTINCT ri.ResolvedIdentityID) AS repeat_count
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN repeat_offenders ro ON ro.pid = ri.ResolvedIdentityID
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
JOIN Unit u        ON u.UnitID        = cm.UnitID
GROUP BY u.UnitName
ORDER BY repeat_count DESC;

questions.question: At this station, what is the average number of cases per offender?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cm.CaseMasterID) * 1.0
     / COUNT(DISTINCT ri.ResolvedIdentityID) AS cases_per_offender
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
JOIN Unit u        ON u.UnitID        = cm.UnitID
WHERE u.UnitName = :station;

questions.question: Show every case registered at this station in the last thirty days.
questions.question_kn: ಕಳೆದ ಮೂವತ್ತು ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ಠಾಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ದಾಖಲಾದ ಎಲ್ಲ ಪ್ರಕರಣ ತೋರಿಸಿ.
questions.sql:
SELECT cm.CrimeNo, cm.CrimeRegisteredDate
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN Unit u ON u.UnitID = cm.UnitID
WHERE u.UnitName = :station
  AND cm.CrimeRegisteredDate >= date(:as_of, '-30 day')
ORDER BY cm.CrimeRegisteredDate DESC;

questions.question: Which offenders known at this station have never been arrested anywhere?
questions.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT ri.ResolvedIdentityID
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
JOIN Unit u        ON u.UnitID        = cm.UnitID
WHERE u.UnitName = :station
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM resolved_identity r2
    JOIN ArrestSurrender ars ON ars.AccusedMasterID = r2.AccusedMasterID
    WHERE r2.ResolvedIdentityID = ri.ResolvedIdentityID
  );

questions.question: Which circle holds the most repeat offenders?
questions.sql:
SELECT parent.UnitName AS circle,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ri.ResolvedIdentityID) AS offenders
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN CaseMaster cm  ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
JOIN Unit u         ON u.UnitID        = cm.UnitID
JOIN Unit parent    ON parent.UnitID   = COALESCE(u.ParentUnitID, u.UnitID)
GROUP BY parent.UnitName
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ri.CaseMasterID) >= 2
ORDER BY offenders DESC;

questions.question: Who has been arrested alongside this person?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಜೊತೆ ಯಾರು ಯಾರು ಬಂಧನಕ್ಕೆ ಒಳಗಾಗಿದ್ದಾರೆ?
questions.sql:
SELECT other.ResolvedIdentityID AS co_accused,
       COUNT(DISTINCT other.CaseMasterID) AS shared_cases
FROM resolved_identity me
JOIN resolved_identity other
  ON other.CaseMasterID = me.CaseMasterID
 AND other.ResolvedIdentityID <> me.ResolvedIdentityID
WHERE me.ResolvedIdentityID = :identity
GROUP BY other.ResolvedIdentityID
ORDER BY shared_cases DESC;

questions.question: How many accused were named in this FIR?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಎಫ್ಐಆರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಆರೋಪಿಗಳ ಹೆಸರಿದೆ?

questions.question: Which co offending pairs appear together in more than one case?
questions.question_kn: ಒಂದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪ್ರಕರಣಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಕಾಣಿಸಿಕೊಂಡ ಜೋಡಿಗಳು ಯಾರು?
questions.sql:
SELECT a.ResolvedIdentityID AS person_a,
       b.ResolvedIdentityID AS person_b,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.CaseMasterID) AS cases_together
FROM resolved_identity a
JOIN resolved_identity b
  ON b.CaseMasterID = a.CaseMasterID
 AND b.ResolvedIdentityID > a.ResolvedIdentityID
GROUP BY a.ResolvedIdentityID, b.ResolvedIdentityID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.CaseMasterID) > 1
ORDER BY cases_together DESC;

questions.question: What is the co offender network around this person, two steps out?
questions.sql:
WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT other.ResolvedIdentityID AS pid
  FROM resolved_identity me
  JOIN resolved_identity other
    ON other.CaseMasterID = me.CaseMasterID
   AND other.ResolvedIdentityID <> me.ResolvedIdentityID
  WHERE me.ResolvedIdentityID = :identity
)
SELECT DISTINCT other.ResolvedIdentityID AS pid, 2 AS step
FROM step1
JOIN resolved_identity me ON me.ResolvedIdentityID = step1.pid
JOIN resolved_identity other
  ON other.CaseMasterID = me.CaseMasterID
 AND other.ResolvedIdentityID NOT IN (SELECT pid FROM step1)
 AND other.ResolvedIdentityID <> :identity;

questions.question: How many co offending links only become visible after identity resolution?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS recovered_links
FROM (
  SELECT a.ResolvedIdentityID AS pa, b.ResolvedIdentityID AS pb
  FROM resolved_identity a
  JOIN resolved_identity b
    ON b.CaseMasterID = a.CaseMasterID
   AND b.ResolvedIdentityID > a.ResolvedIdentityID
  GROUP BY a.ResolvedIdentityID, b.ResolvedIdentityID
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.CaseMasterID) > 1
) t;

questions.question: Which groups of three or more people always appear together?
questions.sql:
SELECT a.ResolvedIdentityID, b.ResolvedIdentityID, c.ResolvedIdentityID,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.CaseMasterID) AS cases_together
FROM resolved_identity a
JOIN resolved_identity b ON b.CaseMasterID = a.CaseMasterID
                        AND b.ResolvedIdentityID > a.ResolvedIdentityID
JOIN resolved_identity c ON c.CaseMasterID = a.CaseMasterID
                        AND c.ResolvedIdentityID > b.ResolvedIdentityID
GROUP BY a.ResolvedIdentityID, b.ResolvedIdentityID, c.ResolvedIdentityID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.CaseMasterID) >= 2;

questions.question: Which offenders always act alone?
questions.question_kn: ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಒಬ್ಬರೇ ಅಪರಾಧ ಎಸಗುವವರು ಯಾರು?
questions.sql:
SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID, COUNT(DISTINCT ri.CaseMasterID) AS cases
FROM resolved_identity ri
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM resolved_identity o
  WHERE o.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
    AND o.ResolvedIdentityID <> ri.ResolvedIdentityID
)
GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ri.CaseMasterID) >= 2
ORDER BY cases DESC;

questions.question: Which person connects two otherwise separate co offending groups?
questions.sql:
SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID,
       COUNT(DISTINCT other.ResolvedIdentityID) AS degree,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ri.CaseMasterID) AS cases
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN resolved_identity other
  ON other.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
 AND other.ResolvedIdentityID <> ri.ResolvedIdentityID
GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT other.ResolvedIdentityID) >= 4
ORDER BY degree DESC;

questions.question: List the other accused named in this FIR.
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಎಫ್ಐಆರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಸರಿಸಲಾದ ಇತರ ಆರೋಪಿಗಳನ್ನು ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮಾಡಿ.
questions.sql:
SELECT a.PersonID, a.AccusedName, a.AgeYear
FROM Accused a
WHERE a.CaseMasterID = :case_id
  AND a.AccusedMasterID <> :accused_id
ORDER BY a.PersonID;

questions.question: How large is the biggest connected co offending group in this district?
questions.sql:
WITH edges AS (
  SELECT a.ResolvedIdentityID AS pa, b.ResolvedIdentityID AS pb
  FROM resolved_identity a
  JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = a.CaseMasterID
  JOIN resolved_identity b
    ON b.CaseMasterID = a.CaseMasterID
   AND b.ResolvedIdentityID > a.ResolvedIdentityID
  WHERE cm.DistrictID = :district_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pid) AS group_size
FROM (SELECT pa AS pid FROM edges UNION SELECT pb FROM edges);

questions.question: For this person, which co accused is the most frequent partner?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಜೊತೆ ಅತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಬಾರಿ ಕಾಣಿಸಿಕೊಂಡ ಸಹ ಆರೋಪಿ ಯಾರು?
questions.sql:
SELECT other.ResolvedIdentityID,
       COUNT(DISTINCT other.CaseMasterID) AS shared_cases
FROM resolved_identity me
JOIN resolved_identity other
  ON other.CaseMasterID = me.CaseMasterID
 AND other.ResolvedIdentityID <> me.ResolvedIdentityID
WHERE me.ResolvedIdentityID = :identity
GROUP BY other.ResolvedIdentityID
ORDER BY shared_cases DESC
LIMIT 1;

questions.question: Do co offending pairs tend to work in the same district or across districts?
questions.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT cm.DistrictID) = 1
            THEN 'same district' ELSE 'across districts' END AS pattern,
       COUNT(*) AS pairs
FROM resolved_identity a
JOIN resolved_identity b
  ON b.CaseMasterID = a.CaseMasterID
 AND b.ResolvedIdentityID > a.ResolvedIdentityID
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = a.CaseMasterID
GROUP BY a.ResolvedIdentityID, b.ResolvedIdentityID;

questions.question: How many people has this person offended with in total?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT other.ResolvedIdentityID) AS associates
FROM resolved_identity me
JOIN resolved_identity other
  ON other.CaseMasterID = me.CaseMasterID
 AND other.ResolvedIdentityID <> me.ResolvedIdentityID
WHERE me.ResolvedIdentityID = :identity;

questions.question: Which co offending groups span the BNS transition of July 2024?
questions.sql:
SELECT a.ResolvedIdentityID, b.ResolvedIdentityID,
       MIN(cm.CrimeRegisteredDate) AS first_together,
       MAX(cm.CrimeRegisteredDate) AS last_together
FROM resolved_identity a
JOIN resolved_identity b
  ON b.CaseMasterID = a.CaseMasterID
 AND b.ResolvedIdentityID > a.ResolvedIdentityID
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = a.CaseMasterID
GROUP BY a.ResolvedIdentityID, b.ResolvedIdentityID
HAVING MIN(cm.CrimeRegisteredDate) < '2024-07-01'
   AND MAX(cm.CrimeRegisteredDate) >= '2024-07-01';

questions.question: Which cases have four or more accused named in them?
questions.question_kn: ನಾಲ್ಕು ಅಥವಾ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಆರೋಪಿಗಳಿರುವ ಪ್ರಕರಣಗಳು ಯಾವುವು?
questions.sql:
SELECT cm.CrimeNo, COUNT(*) AS accused_count
FROM Accused a
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = a.CaseMasterID
GROUP BY cm.CrimeNo
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4
ORDER BY accused_count DESC;

questions.question: Which undetected cases might this person be responsible for?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಯಾವ ಪತ್ತೆಯಾಗದ ಪ್ರಕರಣಗಳಿಗೆ ಕಾರಣವಿರಬಹುದು?
questions.sql:
SELECT cm.CrimeNo, cm.CrimeRegisteredDate, csh.CrimeSubHeadName
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN CrimeSubHead csh ON csh.CrimeSubHeadID = cm.CrimeSubHeadID
WHERE cm.CaseStatus = 'Undetected'
  AND cm.CrimeSubHeadID IN (
    SELECT c2.CrimeSubHeadID
    FROM resolved_identity ri
    JOIN CaseMaster c2 ON c2.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
    WHERE ri.ResolvedIdentityID = :identity
  )
  AND cm.DistrictID IN (
    SELECT c3.DistrictID
    FROM resolved_identity ri
    JOIN CaseMaster c3 ON c3.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
    WHERE ri.ResolvedIdentityID = :identity
  )
ORDER BY cm.CrimeRegisteredDate DESC;

questions.question: How many cases are still undetected in this district?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಪ್ರಕರಣಗಳು ಇನ್ನೂ ಪತ್ತೆಯಾಗಿಲ್ಲ?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS undetected
FROM CaseMaster
WHERE DistrictID = :district_id
  AND CaseStatus = 'Undetected';

questions.question: For this undetected case, who are the ten most likely known offenders?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಪತ್ತೆಯಾಗದ ಪ್ರಕರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಭಾವ್ಯ ಹತ್ತು ಅಪರಾಧಿಗಳು ಯಾರು?
questions.sql:
SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c2.CrimeSubHeadID = target.CrimeSubHeadID THEN 2 ELSE 0 END)
     + SUM(CASE WHEN c2.DistrictID     = target.DistrictID     THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       AS affinity
FROM CaseMaster target
CROSS JOIN resolved_identity ri
JOIN CaseMaster c2 ON c2.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
WHERE target.CaseMasterID = :case_id
GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
ORDER BY affinity DESC
LIMIT 10;

questions.question: Which undetected cases match the modus of a known offender at this station?
questions.sql:
SELECT cm.CrimeNo, csh.CrimeSubHeadName, ri.ResolvedIdentityID
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN CrimeSubHead csh ON csh.CrimeSubHeadID = cm.CrimeSubHeadID
JOIN resolved_identity ri
  ON ri.CaseMasterID IN (
       SELECT c2.CaseMasterID FROM CaseMaster c2
       WHERE c2.CrimeSubHeadID = cm.CrimeSubHeadID
         AND c2.CaseStatus <> 'Undetected'
     )
JOIN CaseMaster known ON known.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
JOIN Unit u ON u.UnitID = known.UnitID
WHERE cm.CaseStatus = 'Undetected' AND u.UnitName = :station;

questions.question: What is the detection rate for this crime head?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಅಪರಾಧ ವಿಭಾಗದ ಪತ್ತೆ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಎಷ್ಟು?
questions.sql:
SELECT ch.CrimeHeadName,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cm.CaseStatus <> 'Undetected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
     / COUNT(*) AS detection_rate
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN CrimeHead ch ON ch.CrimeHeadID = cm.CrimeHeadID
WHERE ch.CrimeHeadName = :head
GROUP BY ch.CrimeHeadName;

questions.question: Which undetected cases fall inside a known offender's active window and district?
questions.sql:
WITH active AS (
  SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID AS pid, cm.DistrictID,
         MIN(cm.CrimeRegisteredDate) AS first_seen,
         MAX(cm.CrimeRegisteredDate) AS last_seen
  FROM resolved_identity ri
  JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
  GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID, cm.DistrictID
)
SELECT u.CrimeNo, a.pid
FROM CaseMaster u
JOIN active a ON a.DistrictID = u.DistrictID
             AND u.CrimeRegisteredDate BETWEEN a.first_seen AND a.last_seen
WHERE u.CaseStatus = 'Undetected';

questions.question: How many undetected cases are there per crime sub head?
questions.question_kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಪರಾಧ ಉಪವಿಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಪ್ರಕರಣ ಪತ್ತೆಯಾಗಿಲ್ಲ?
questions.sql:
SELECT csh.CrimeSubHeadName, COUNT(*) AS undetected
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN CrimeSubHead csh ON csh.CrimeSubHeadID = cm.CrimeSubHeadID
WHERE cm.CaseStatus = 'Undetected'
GROUP BY csh.CrimeSubHeadName
ORDER BY undetected DESC;

questions.question: If we resolve identities, how many undetected cases gain a candidate?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.CaseMasterID) AS cases_with_candidate
FROM CaseMaster u
JOIN resolved_identity ri
JOIN CaseMaster k ON k.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
WHERE u.CaseStatus = 'Undetected'
  AND k.CrimeSubHeadID = u.CrimeSubHeadID
  AND k.DistrictID     = u.DistrictID;

questions.question: Which undetected cases are the oldest still open at this station?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಠಾಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅತಿ ಹಳೆಯ ಬಾಕಿ ಇರುವ ಪ್ರಕರಣಗಳು ಯಾವುವು?
questions.sql:
SELECT cm.CrimeNo, cm.CrimeRegisteredDate
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN Unit u ON u.UnitID = cm.UnitID
WHERE u.UnitName = :station AND cm.CaseStatus = 'Undetected'
ORDER BY cm.CrimeRegisteredDate
LIMIT 20;

questions.question: Rank known offenders by how many undetected cases in their district match their modus.
questions.sql:
SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID, COUNT(DISTINCT u.CaseMasterID) AS matches
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN CaseMaster k ON k.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
JOIN CaseMaster u ON u.CaseStatus = 'Undetected'
                 AND u.DistrictID     = k.DistrictID
                 AND u.CrimeSubHeadID = k.CrimeSubHeadID
GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
ORDER BY matches DESC
LIMIT 25;

questions.question: How many cases were detected this month?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ತಿಂಗಳು ಎಷ್ಟು ಪ್ರಕರಣ ಪತ್ತೆಯಾಗಿವೆ?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS detected
FROM CaseMaster
WHERE CaseStatus <> 'Undetected'
  AND CrimeRegisteredDate >= :from_date
  AND CrimeRegisteredDate <  :to_date;

questions.question: For this undetected case, which known offenders were active nearby at the time?
questions.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT ri.ResolvedIdentityID
FROM CaseMaster target
JOIN CaseMaster k ON k.DistrictID = target.DistrictID
                 AND ABS(julianday(k.CrimeRegisteredDate)
                       - julianday(target.CrimeRegisteredDate)) <= 180
JOIN resolved_identity ri ON ri.CaseMasterID = k.CaseMasterID
WHERE target.CaseMasterID = :case_id;

questions.question: What proportion of undetected cases have at least one plausible known offender?
questions.sql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.candidates > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
     / COUNT(*) AS coverage
FROM (
  SELECT u.CaseMasterID,
         COUNT(DISTINCT ri.ResolvedIdentityID) AS candidates
  FROM CaseMaster u
  LEFT JOIN CaseMaster k ON k.DistrictID     = u.DistrictID
                        AND k.CrimeSubHeadID = u.CrimeSubHeadID
                        AND k.CaseStatus <> 'Undetected'
  LEFT JOIN resolved_identity ri ON ri.CaseMasterID = k.CaseMasterID
  WHERE u.CaseStatus = 'Undetected'
  GROUP BY u.CaseMasterID
) c;

questions.question: List undetected cases of this sub head in the last six months.
questions.sql:
SELECT cm.CrimeNo, cm.CrimeRegisteredDate
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN CrimeSubHead csh ON csh.CrimeSubHeadID = cm.CrimeSubHeadID
WHERE cm.CaseStatus = 'Undetected'
  AND csh.CrimeSubHeadName = :offence
  AND cm.CrimeRegisteredDate >= date(:as_of, '-6 month')
ORDER BY cm.CrimeRegisteredDate DESC;

questions.question: Which offenders have a gap in their record that an undetected case would fill?
questions.sql:
WITH appearances AS (
  SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID AS pid, cm.CrimeRegisteredDate AS on_date,
         cm.DistrictID
  FROM resolved_identity ri
  JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
)
SELECT a.pid, u.CrimeNo, u.CrimeRegisteredDate
FROM appearances a
JOIN appearances b ON b.pid = a.pid AND b.on_date > a.on_date
JOIN CaseMaster u  ON u.CaseStatus = 'Undetected'
                  AND u.DistrictID = a.DistrictID
                  AND u.CrimeRegisteredDate BETWEEN a.on_date AND b.on_date
WHERE julianday(b.on_date) - julianday(a.on_date) > 180;

questions.question: How has theft changed over the last three years, counting IPC and BNS together?
questions.question_kn: ಕಳೆದ ಮೂರು ವರ್ಷಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕಳ್ಳತನ ಪ್ರಕರಣಗಳ ಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿ ಹೇಗಿದೆ?
questions.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y', cm.CrimeRegisteredDate) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT cm.CaseMasterID) AS cases
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN ActSectionAssociation asa ON asa.CaseMasterID = cm.CaseMasterID
JOIN Act a         ON a.ActID = asa.ActID
JOIN Section s     ON s.SectionID = asa.SectionID
WHERE (a.ActAbbr = 'IPC' AND s.SectionNo IN ('378','379'))
   OR (a.ActAbbr = 'BNS' AND s.SectionNo IN ('303'))
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;

questions.question: How many cases were registered under BNS since July 2024?
questions.question_kn: ಜುಲೈ 2024 ರಿಂದ ಬಿಎನ್ಎಸ್ ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಪ್ರಕರಣ ದಾಖಲಾಗಿವೆ?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cm.CaseMasterID) AS bns_cases
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN ActSectionAssociation asa ON asa.CaseMasterID = cm.CaseMasterID
JOIN Act a ON a.ActID = asa.ActID
WHERE a.ActAbbr = 'BNS';

questions.question: By how much does a naive IPC only query undercount this offence across the transition?
questions.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.ActAbbr = 'IPC' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS naive_count,
  COUNT(*) AS reconciled_count,
  1.0 - SUM(CASE WHEN a.ActAbbr = 'IPC' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
      / COUNT(*) AS undercount_share
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN ActSectionAssociation asa ON asa.CaseMasterID = cm.CaseMasterID
JOIN Act a     ON a.ActID = asa.ActID
JOIN Section s ON s.SectionID = asa.SectionID
WHERE s.SectionNo IN (:ipc_section, :bns_section);

questions.question: Which IPC section corresponds to this BNS section?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಬಿಎನ್ಎಸ್ ಸೆಕ್ಷನ್‌ಗೆ ಸಮಾನವಾದ ಐಪಿಸಿ ಸೆಕ್ಷನ್ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.sql:
SELECT ipc.SectionNo AS ipc_section, bns.SectionNo AS bns_section,
       ipc.SectionDesc
FROM Section bns
JOIN Act ba ON ba.ActID = bns.ActID AND ba.ActAbbr = 'BNS'
JOIN Section ipc ON ipc.SectionDesc = bns.SectionDesc
JOIN Act ia ON ia.ActID = ipc.ActID AND ia.ActAbbr = 'IPC'
WHERE bns.SectionNo = :bns_section;

questions.question: Show the monthly case count either side of 1 July 2024 for this offence.
questions.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', cm.CrimeRegisteredDate) AS month,
       CASE WHEN cm.CrimeRegisteredDate < '2024-07-01'
            THEN 'IPC era' ELSE 'BNS era' END AS era,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cm.CaseMasterID) AS cases
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN ActSectionAssociation asa ON asa.CaseMasterID = cm.CaseMasterID
JOIN Section s ON s.SectionID = asa.SectionID
WHERE s.SectionNo IN (:ipc_section, :bns_section)
GROUP BY month, era
ORDER BY month;

questions.question: How many distinct sections appear in the record?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS sections FROM Section;

questions.question: Which offences show the largest change in volume after the BNS switch?
questions.sql:
SELECT s.SectionDesc,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cm.CrimeRegisteredDate <  '2024-07-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS before_switch,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cm.CrimeRegisteredDate >= '2024-07-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS after_switch
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN ActSectionAssociation asa ON asa.CaseMasterID = cm.CaseMasterID
JOIN Section s ON s.SectionID = asa.SectionID
GROUP BY s.SectionDesc
ORDER BY ABS(after_switch - before_switch) DESC;

questions.question: For this offender, list their cases under both IPC and BNS sections.
questions.sql:
SELECT cm.CrimeNo, cm.CrimeRegisteredDate,
       a.ActAbbr, s.SectionNo, s.SectionDesc
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
JOIN ActSectionAssociation asa ON asa.CaseMasterID = cm.CaseMasterID
JOIN Act a     ON a.ActID     = asa.ActID
JOIN Section s ON s.SectionID = asa.SectionID
WHERE ri.ResolvedIdentityID = :identity
ORDER BY cm.CrimeRegisteredDate;

questions.question: How many cases carry both an IPC and a BNS section, which should not happen?
questions.sql:
SELECT cm.CrimeNo, cm.CrimeRegisteredDate
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN ActSectionAssociation asa ON asa.CaseMasterID = cm.CaseMasterID
JOIN Act a ON a.ActID = asa.ActID
GROUP BY cm.CaseMasterID
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN a.ActAbbr = 'IPC' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN a.ActAbbr = 'BNS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0;

questions.question: Is the drop in IPC filings after July 2024 matched by a rise in BNS filings?
questions.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', cm.CrimeRegisteredDate) AS month,
       SUM(CASE WHEN a.ActAbbr = 'IPC' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ipc,
       SUM(CASE WHEN a.ActAbbr = 'BNS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bns
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN ActSectionAssociation asa ON asa.CaseMasterID = cm.CaseMasterID
JOIN Act a ON a.ActID = asa.ActID
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

questions.question: Which act was this case registered under?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಪ್ರಕರಣ ಯಾವ ಕಾಯ್ದೆಯಡಿ ದಾಖಲಾಗಿದೆ?
questions.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.ActName, a.ActAbbr
FROM ActSectionAssociation asa
JOIN Act a ON a.ActID = asa.ActID
WHERE asa.CaseMasterID = :case_id;

questions.question: Count cases per act abbreviation per year.
questions.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y', cm.CrimeRegisteredDate) AS year,
       a.ActAbbr, COUNT(DISTINCT cm.CaseMasterID) AS cases
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN ActSectionAssociation asa ON asa.CaseMasterID = cm.CaseMasterID
JOIN Act a ON a.ActID = asa.ActID
GROUP BY year, a.ActAbbr
ORDER BY year, a.ActAbbr;

questions.question: Reconciled across the transition, which offence is actually rising fastest?
questions.sql:
WITH reconciled AS (
  SELECT s.SectionDesc AS offence,
         strftime('%Y', cm.CrimeRegisteredDate) AS year,
         COUNT(DISTINCT cm.CaseMasterID) AS cases
  FROM CaseMaster cm
  JOIN ActSectionAssociation asa ON asa.CaseMasterID = cm.CaseMasterID
  JOIN Section s ON s.SectionID = asa.SectionID
  GROUP BY offence, year
)
SELECT offence,
       MAX(CASE WHEN year = :recent THEN cases END)
     - MAX(CASE WHEN year = :baseline THEN cases END) AS growth
FROM reconciled
GROUP BY offence
ORDER BY growth DESC;

questions.question: How many sections have no case registered under them at all?
What is the earliest and latest case date in the record?
Which areas have the most cases of this crime head?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಅಪರಾಧ ವಿಭಾಗದ ಪ್ರಕರಣ ಅತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಇರುವ ಪ್ರದೇಶ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.sql:
SELECT u.UnitName, COUNT(*) AS cases
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN CrimeHead ch ON ch.CrimeHeadID = cm.CrimeHeadID
JOIN Unit u       ON u.UnitID       = cm.UnitID
WHERE ch.CrimeHeadName = :head
GROUP BY u.UnitName
ORDER BY cases DESC
LIMIT 20;

questions.question: Which areas have the highest density of distinct offenders rather than of cases?
questions.sql:
SELECT u.UnitName,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ri.ResolvedIdentityID) AS offenders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cm.CaseMasterID) AS cases
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
JOIN Unit u        ON u.UnitID        = cm.UnitID
GROUP BY u.UnitName
ORDER BY offenders DESC
LIMIT 20;

questions.question: How many cases of each crime head were registered?
questions.question_kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಪರಾಧ ವಿಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಪ್ರಕರಣ ದಾಖಲಾಗಿವೆ?
questions.sql:
SELECT ch.CrimeHeadName, COUNT(*) AS cases
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN CrimeHead ch ON ch.CrimeHeadID = cm.CrimeHeadID
GROUP BY ch.CrimeHeadName
ORDER BY cases DESC;

questions.question: Which month had an unusual spike in cases in this district?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವ ತಿಂಗಳು ಪ್ರಕರಣಗಳು ಅಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿವೆ?
questions.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', CrimeRegisteredDate) AS month, COUNT(*) AS cases
FROM CaseMaster
WHERE DistrictID = :district_id
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY cases DESC;

questions.question: For this crime head, is offender density concentrated or spread across the district?
questions.sql:
SELECT u.UnitName,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ri.ResolvedIdentityID) AS offenders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ri.ResolvedIdentityID) * 1.0
     / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT ri.ResolvedIdentityID)) OVER () AS share
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
JOIN CrimeHead ch  ON ch.CrimeHeadID  = cm.CrimeHeadID
JOIN Unit u        ON u.UnitID        = cm.UnitID
WHERE ch.CrimeHeadName = :head AND cm.DistrictID = :district_id
GROUP BY u.UnitName
ORDER BY offenders DESC;

questions.question: What is the busiest day of the week for case registration?
questions.sql:
SELECT strftime('%w', CrimeRegisteredDate) AS weekday, COUNT(*) AS cases
FROM CaseMaster
GROUP BY weekday
ORDER BY cases DESC;

questions.question: Which stations show a rise in this crime head over the last twelve months?
questions.sql:
SELECT u.UnitName,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cm.CrimeRegisteredDate >= date(:as_of, '-12 month')
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cm.CrimeRegisteredDate <  date(:as_of, '-12 month')
            AND cm.CrimeRegisteredDate >= date(:as_of, '-24 month')
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prior
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN CrimeHead ch ON ch.CrimeHeadID = cm.CrimeHeadID
JOIN Unit u       ON u.UnitID       = cm.UnitID
WHERE ch.CrimeHeadName = :head
GROUP BY u.UnitName
HAVING recent > prior
ORDER BY recent - prior DESC;

questions.question: Which crime sub head is most common in this district?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅತಿ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಅಪರಾಧ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.sql:
SELECT csh.CrimeSubHeadName, COUNT(*) AS cases
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN CrimeSubHead csh ON csh.CrimeSubHeadID = cm.CrimeSubHeadID
WHERE cm.DistrictID = :district_id
GROUP BY csh.CrimeSubHeadName
ORDER BY cases DESC
LIMIT 1;

questions.question: Do hotspots by case count agree with hotspots by offender count?
questions.sql:
SELECT u.UnitName,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cm.CaseMasterID) AS cases,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ri.ResolvedIdentityID) AS offenders,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT cm.CaseMasterID) DESC) AS rank_by_cases,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ri.ResolvedIdentityID) DESC) AS rank_by_offenders
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
JOIN Unit u        ON u.UnitID        = cm.UnitID
GROUP BY u.UnitName;

questions.question: How many cases per gravity band in this district?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗಂಭೀರತೆಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಎಷ್ಟು ಪ್ರಕರಣಗಳಿವೆ?
questions.sql:
SELECT g.GravityName, COUNT(*) AS cases
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN GravityOffence g ON g.GravityOffenceID = cm.GravityOffenceID
WHERE cm.DistrictID = :district_id
GROUP BY g.GravityName
ORDER BY cases DESC;

questions.question: Which district and month combinations exceed twice their trailing median?
questions.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT DistrictID, strftime('%Y-%m', CrimeRegisteredDate) AS month,
         COUNT(*) AS cases
  FROM CaseMaster
  GROUP BY DistrictID, month
)
SELECT m.DistrictID, m.month, m.cases
FROM monthly m
WHERE m.cases > 2.0 * (
  SELECT AVG(p.cases) FROM monthly p
  WHERE p.DistrictID = m.DistrictID AND p.month < m.month
)
ORDER BY m.cases DESC;

questions.question: How many cases are there in total in the record?
questions.question_kn: ದಾಖಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಟ್ಟು ಎಷ್ಟು ಪ್ರಕರಣಗಳಿವೆ?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cases FROM CaseMaster;

questions.question: Which case category accounts for the most cases?
questions.sql:
SELECT cc.CaseCategoryName, COUNT(*) AS cases
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN CaseCategory cc ON cc.CaseCategoryID = cm.CaseCategoryID
GROUP BY cc.CaseCategoryName
ORDER BY cases DESC;

questions.question: After resolution, how much smaller is the apparent offender population in each district?
questions.sql:
SELECT cm.DistrictID,
       COUNT(*) AS accused_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ri.ResolvedIdentityID) AS actual_people,
       COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT ri.ResolvedIdentityID) AS inflation_removed
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
GROUP BY cm.DistrictID
ORDER BY inflation_removed DESC;

questions.question: Which crime sub heads are rising statewide this year?
questions.sql:
SELECT csh.CrimeSubHeadName,
       SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', cm.CrimeRegisteredDate) = :recent   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS this_year,
       SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', cm.CrimeRegisteredDate) = :baseline THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_year
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN CrimeSubHead csh ON csh.CrimeSubHeadID = cm.CrimeSubHeadID
GROUP BY csh.CrimeSubHeadName
ORDER BY this_year - last_year DESC;

questions.question: What is the arrest history of this person across all their cases?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಬಂಧನದ ಇತಿಹಾಸ ಏನು?
questions.sql:
SELECT cm.CrimeNo, ars.ArrestDate, ars.ArrestType, ars.ArrestingOfficerID
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN ArrestSurrender ars ON ars.AccusedMasterID = ri.AccusedMasterID
JOIN CaseMaster cm       ON cm.CaseMasterID     = ri.CaseMasterID
WHERE ri.ResolvedIdentityID = :identity
ORDER BY ars.ArrestDate;

questions.question: Was this accused arrested?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಆರೋಪಿಯನ್ನು ಬಂಧಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆಯೇ?

questions.question: How many people have been arrested more than three times across all districts?
questions.question_kn: ಎಲ್ಲ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂರಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಬಾರಿ ಬಂಧನಕ್ಕೆ ಒಳಗಾದವರು ಎಷ್ಟು ಮಂದಿ?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_arrests
FROM (
  SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID
  FROM resolved_identity ri
  JOIN ArrestSurrender ars ON ars.AccusedMasterID = ri.AccusedMasterID
  GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
) t;

questions.question: Which officer has made the most arrests?
questions.question_kn: ಅತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಬಂಧನ ಮಾಡಿದ ಅಧಿಕಾರಿ ಯಾರು?
questions.sql:
SELECT e.EmployeeName, COUNT(*) AS arrests
FROM ArrestSurrender ars
JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeID = ars.ArrestingOfficerID
GROUP BY e.EmployeeName
ORDER BY arrests DESC
LIMIT 10;

questions.question: Which people were arrested by the same officer in different districts?
questions.sql:
SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID, ars.ArrestingOfficerID,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cm.DistrictID) AS districts
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN ArrestSurrender ars ON ars.AccusedMasterID = ri.AccusedMasterID
JOIN CaseMaster cm       ON cm.CaseMasterID     = ri.CaseMasterID
GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID, ars.ArrestingOfficerID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cm.DistrictID) > 1;

questions.question: How many arrests were made at this station last month?
questions.question_kn: ಕಳೆದ ತಿಂಗಳು ಈ ಠಾಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಬಂಧನ ಆಗಿವೆ?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS arrests
FROM ArrestSurrender ars
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ars.CaseMasterID
JOIN Unit u        ON u.UnitID        = cm.UnitID
WHERE u.UnitName = :station
  AND ars.ArrestDate >= :from_date
  AND ars.ArrestDate <  :to_date;

questions.question: What is the average gap between case registration and arrest?
Which repeat offenders have never been arrested despite multiple cases?
questions.question_kn: ಹಲವು ಪ್ರಕರಣಗಳಿದ್ದರೂ ಎಂದೂ ಬಂಧನಕ್ಕೆ ಒಳಗಾಗದವರು ಯಾರು?
questions.sql:
SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID, COUNT(DISTINCT ri.CaseMasterID) AS cases
FROM resolved_identity ri
GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ri.CaseMasterID) >= 3
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM ArrestSurrender ars
         WHERE ars.AccusedMasterID = ri.AccusedMasterID
       ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0;

questions.question: What type of arrest was recorded, arrest or surrender?
For each officer, how many distinct people rather than distinct rows have they arrested?
questions.sql:
SELECT e.EmployeeName,
       COUNT(*) AS arrest_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ri.ResolvedIdentityID) AS distinct_people
FROM ArrestSurrender ars
JOIN Employee e            ON e.EmployeeID = ars.ArrestingOfficerID
JOIN resolved_identity ri  ON ri.AccusedMasterID = ars.AccusedMasterID
GROUP BY e.EmployeeName
ORDER BY distinct_people DESC;

questions.question: Which arrests happened more than a year after the case was registered?
questions.sql:
SELECT cm.CrimeNo, cm.CrimeRegisteredDate, ars.ArrestDate
FROM ArrestSurrender ars
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ars.CaseMasterID
WHERE julianday(ars.ArrestDate) - julianday(cm.CrimeRegisteredDate) > 365
ORDER BY ars.ArrestDate DESC;

questions.question: Does arresting a repeat offender reduce their subsequent case rate?
questions.sql:
WITH first_arrest AS (
  SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID AS pid, MIN(ars.ArrestDate) AS on_date
  FROM resolved_identity ri
  JOIN ArrestSurrender ars ON ars.AccusedMasterID = ri.AccusedMasterID
  GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
)
SELECT fa.pid,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cm.CrimeRegisteredDate <  fa.on_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS before_arrest,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cm.CrimeRegisteredDate >= fa.on_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS after_arrest
FROM first_arrest fa
JOIN resolved_identity ri ON ri.ResolvedIdentityID = fa.pid
JOIN CaseMaster cm        ON cm.CaseMasterID       = ri.CaseMasterID
GROUP BY fa.pid;

questions.question: List all arrests recorded for this case.
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಪ್ರಕರಣದಲ್ಲಿ ದಾಖಲಾದ ಎಲ್ಲ ಬಂಧನಗಳನ್ನು ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮಾಡಿ.
questions.sql:
SELECT ArrestSurrenderID, AccusedMasterID, ArrestDate, ArrestType
FROM ArrestSurrender
WHERE CaseMasterID = :case_id
ORDER BY ArrestDate;

questions.question: How many accused have been arrested in more than one district?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS people
FROM (
  SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID
  FROM resolved_identity ri
  JOIN ArrestSurrender ars ON ars.AccusedMasterID = ri.AccusedMasterID
  JOIN CaseMaster cm       ON cm.CaseMasterID     = ri.CaseMasterID
  GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cm.DistrictID) > 1
) t;

questions.question: Which officers repeatedly arrest the same person, suggesting a beat relationship?
questions.sql:
SELECT ars.ArrestingOfficerID, ri.ResolvedIdentityID, COUNT(*) AS times
FROM ArrestSurrender ars
JOIN resolved_identity ri ON ri.AccusedMasterID = ars.AccusedMasterID
GROUP BY ars.ArrestingOfficerID, ri.ResolvedIdentityID
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY times DESC;

questions.question: Find every accused row with this name.
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಹೆಸರಿನ ಎಲ್ಲ ಆರೋಪಿ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕಿ.

questions.question: Find this person however their name was spelt, including in Kannada.
questions.question_kn: ಹೆಸರು ಯಾವ ರೀತಿ ಬರೆದಿದ್ದರೂ, ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿದ್ದರೂ, ಈ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕಿ.
questions.sql:
SELECT a.AccusedName, a.CaseMasterID, ri.ResolvedIdentityID
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN Accused a ON a.AccusedMasterID = ri.AccusedMasterID
WHERE ri.ResolvedIdentityID = (
  SELECT r2.ResolvedIdentityID
  FROM resolved_identity r2
  JOIN Accused a2 ON a2.AccusedMasterID = r2.AccusedMasterID
  WHERE a2.AccusedName = :name
  LIMIT 1
);

questions.question: Which identities are recorded under the most different spellings?
questions.question_kn: ಅತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ವಿಭಿನ್ನ ಕಾಗುಣಿತಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ದಾಖಲಾದ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳು ಯಾರು?
questions.sql:
SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.AccusedName) AS spellings,
       COUNT(*) AS rows_held
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN Accused a ON a.AccusedMasterID = ri.AccusedMasterID
GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.AccusedName) > 1
ORDER BY spellings DESC;

questions.question: Which identities appear in both Kannada and Latin script?
questions.question_kn: ಕನ್ನಡ ಮತ್ತು ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್ ಎರಡೂ ಲಿಪಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ದಾಖಲಾದವರು ಯಾರು?
questions.sql:
SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID, COUNT(DISTINCT a.AccusedName) AS renderings
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN Accused a ON a.AccusedMasterID = ri.AccusedMasterID
GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN a.AccusedName GLOB '*[ಀ-೿]*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN a.AccusedName GLOB '*[A-Za-z]*'        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0;

questions.question: How many accused rows share an identical name string?
questions.sql:
SELECT AccusedName, COUNT(*) AS rows_held
FROM Accused
GROUP BY AccusedName
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY rows_held DESC;

questions.question: Which identical name strings actually belong to different people?
questions.sql:
SELECT a.AccusedName,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ri.ResolvedIdentityID) AS distinct_people,
       COUNT(*) AS rows_held
FROM Accused a
JOIN resolved_identity ri ON ri.AccusedMasterID = a.AccusedMasterID
GROUP BY a.AccusedName
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ri.ResolvedIdentityID) > 1
ORDER BY distinct_people DESC;

questions.question: Search for accused whose name starts with these letters.
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳಿಂದ ಆರಂಭವಾಗುವ ಹೆಸರಿನ ಆರೋಪಿಗಳನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕಿ.
questions.sql:
SELECT AccusedMasterID, AccusedName, CaseMasterID
FROM Accused
WHERE AccusedName LIKE :prefix || '%'
ORDER BY AccusedName;

questions.question: How many people would a plain GROUP BY on name wrongly merge?
questions.sql:
SELECT SUM(distinct_people - 1) AS wrong_merges
FROM (
  SELECT a.AccusedName, COUNT(DISTINCT ri.ResolvedIdentityID) AS distinct_people
  FROM Accused a
  JOIN resolved_identity ri ON ri.AccusedMasterID = a.AccusedMasterID
  GROUP BY a.AccusedName
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ri.ResolvedIdentityID) > 1
) t;

questions.question: How many people would a plain GROUP BY on name wrongly split?
questions.sql:
SELECT SUM(spellings - 1) AS wrong_splits
FROM (
  SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID, COUNT(DISTINCT a.AccusedName) AS spellings
  FROM resolved_identity ri
  JOIN Accused a ON a.AccusedMasterID = ri.AccusedMasterID
  GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.AccusedName) > 1
) t;

questions.question: Show every recorded name for this identity, with the case each came from.
questions.question_kn: ಈ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗೆ ದಾಖಲಾದ ಎಲ್ಲ ಹೆಸರುಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರಕರಣ ಸಹಿತ ತೋರಿಸಿ.
questions.sql:
SELECT a.AccusedName, cm.CrimeNo, cm.CrimeRegisteredDate
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN Accused a     ON a.AccusedMasterID = ri.AccusedMasterID
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID   = ri.CaseMasterID
WHERE ri.ResolvedIdentityID = :identity
ORDER BY cm.CrimeRegisteredDate;

questions.question: Which names differ only by a trailing vowel?
questions.sql:
SELECT a.AccusedName AS name_a, b.AccusedName AS name_b
FROM Accused a
JOIN Accused b ON b.AccusedName = a.AccusedName || 'a'
GROUP BY name_a, name_b;

questions.question: How many distinct name strings are in the accused table?
For a given name, which identities does it resolve to and with what confidence?
questions.sql:
SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID, COUNT(*) AS rows_held,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ri.CaseMasterID) AS cases
FROM Accused a
JOIN resolved_identity ri ON ri.AccusedMasterID = a.AccusedMasterID
WHERE a.AccusedName = :name
GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID;

questions.question: Which accused names carry an initial rather than a full patronymic?
questions.sql:
SELECT AccusedMasterID, AccusedName
FROM Accused
WHERE AccusedName LIKE '_. %' OR AccusedName LIKE '_ %'
ORDER BY AccusedName;

questions.question: How many identities did resolution recover that exact name matching would have missed?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS recovered_identities
FROM (
  SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID
  FROM resolved_identity ri
  JOIN Accused a ON a.AccusedMasterID = ri.AccusedMasterID
  GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.AccusedName) > 1
) t;

questions.question: How many victims are recorded in this district?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಸಂತ್ರಸ್ತರು ದಾಖಲಾಗಿದ್ದಾರೆ?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS victims
FROM Victim v
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = v.CaseMasterID
WHERE cm.DistrictID = :district_id;

questions.question: Which people have been a victim in more than one case?
questions.question_kn: ಒಂದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪ್ರಕರಣಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂತ್ರಸ್ತರಾದವರು ಯಾರು?
questions.sql:
SELECT rv.ResolvedIdentityID, COUNT(DISTINCT rv.CaseMasterID) AS cases
FROM resolved_victim rv
GROUP BY rv.ResolvedIdentityID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rv.CaseMasterID) > 1
ORDER BY cases DESC;

questions.question: Which complainants have filed more than one FIR?
questions.question_kn: ಒಂದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಎಫ್ಐಆರ್ ದಾಖಲಿಸಿದ ದೂರುದಾರರು ಯಾರು?
questions.sql:
SELECT rc.ResolvedIdentityID, COUNT(DISTINCT rc.CaseMasterID) AS firs_filed
FROM resolved_complainant rc
GROUP BY rc.ResolvedIdentityID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rc.CaseMasterID) > 1
ORDER BY firs_filed DESC;

questions.question: Is anyone recorded as both a victim and an accused?
questions.question_kn: ಯಾರಾದರೂ ಸಂತ್ರಸ್ತರೂ ಆರೋಪಿಯೂ ಆಗಿ ದಾಖಲಾಗಿದ್ದಾರೆಯೇ?
questions.sql:
SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN resolved_victim rv ON rv.ResolvedIdentityID = ri.ResolvedIdentityID
GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID;

questions.question: How many complainants filed on their own behalf rather than for someone else?
questions.sql:
SELECT RelationToVictim, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM ComplainantDetails
GROUP BY RelationToVictim
ORDER BY n DESC;

questions.question: How many distinct people do the complainant rows actually represent?
Which complainant phone numbers appear on more than one FIR?
questions.sql:
SELECT PhoneNumber, COUNT(DISTINCT CaseMasterID) AS firs
FROM ComplainantDetails
WHERE PhoneNumber IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY PhoneNumber
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CaseMasterID) > 1
ORDER BY firs DESC;

questions.question: Do repeat complainants cluster in particular localities?
questions.sql:
SELECT c.Address, COUNT(DISTINCT rc.ResolvedIdentityID) AS repeat_people
FROM resolved_complainant rc
JOIN ComplainantDetails c ON c.ComplainantID = rc.ComplainantID
WHERE rc.ResolvedIdentityID IN (
  SELECT r2.ResolvedIdentityID FROM resolved_complainant r2
  GROUP BY r2.ResolvedIdentityID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r2.CaseMasterID) > 1
)
GROUP BY c.Address
ORDER BY repeat_people DESC;

questions.question: What is the age distribution of victims for this crime head?
questions.sql:
SELECT v.AgeYear, COUNT(*) AS victims
FROM Victim v
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = v.CaseMasterID
JOIN CrimeHead ch  ON ch.CrimeHeadID  = cm.CrimeHeadID
WHERE ch.CrimeHeadName = :head
GROUP BY v.AgeYear
ORDER BY v.AgeYear;

questions.question: For a repeat victim, is the same offender involved each time?
questions.sql:
SELECT rv.ResolvedIdentityID AS victim,
       ri.ResolvedIdentityID AS accused,
       COUNT(DISTINCT rv.CaseMasterID) AS shared_cases
FROM resolved_victim rv
JOIN resolved_identity ri ON ri.CaseMasterID = rv.CaseMasterID
GROUP BY rv.ResolvedIdentityID, ri.ResolvedIdentityID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rv.CaseMasterID) > 1;

questions.question: How many cases have a victim recorded at all?
Across accused, victims and complainants, how many rows collapse to how many people?
questions.sql:
SELECT 'accused' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS rows_held,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ResolvedIdentityID) AS people
FROM resolved_identity
UNION ALL
SELECT 'victim', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT ResolvedIdentityID)
FROM resolved_victim
UNION ALL
SELECT 'complainant', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT ResolvedIdentityID)
FROM resolved_complainant;

questions.question: How many cases ended in a chargesheet?
questions.question_kn: ಎಷ್ಟು ಪ್ರಕರಣಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ದೋಷಾರೋಪ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CaseMasterID) AS chargesheeted
FROM ChargesheetDetails;

questions.question: What is the chargesheet rate by district?
questions.question_kn: ಜಿಲ್ಲಾವಾರು ದೋಷಾರೋಪ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಎಷ್ಟು?
questions.sql:
SELECT d.DistrictName,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cs.CaseMasterID) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT cm.CaseMasterID) AS rate
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN District d ON d.DistrictID = cm.DistrictID
LEFT JOIN ChargesheetDetails cs ON cs.CaseMasterID = cm.CaseMasterID
GROUP BY d.DistrictName
ORDER BY rate DESC;

questions.question: Do repeat offenders get chargesheeted at a different rate from first timers?
questions.sql:
WITH history AS (
  SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID AS pid, COUNT(DISTINCT ri.CaseMasterID) AS cases
  FROM resolved_identity ri
  GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
)
SELECT CASE WHEN h.cases > 1 THEN 'repeat' ELSE 'first time' END AS band,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cs.CaseMasterID) * 1.0
     / COUNT(DISTINCT ri.CaseMasterID) AS chargesheet_rate
FROM history h
JOIN resolved_identity ri ON ri.ResolvedIdentityID = h.pid
LEFT JOIN ChargesheetDetails cs ON cs.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
GROUP BY band;

questions.question: What is the final report type for this case?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಪ್ರಕರಣದ ಅಂತಿಮ ವರದಿ ಯಾವ ಬಗೆಯದು?

questions.question: How many cases closed as B report, meaning false or mistake of fact?
What is the median days from registration to chargesheet, by crime head?
questions.sql:
SELECT ch.CrimeHeadName,
       AVG(julianday(cs.ChargesheetDate) - julianday(cm.CrimeRegisteredDate)) AS avg_days
FROM ChargesheetDetails cs
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = cs.CaseMasterID
JOIN CrimeHead ch  ON ch.CrimeHeadID  = cm.CrimeHeadID
GROUP BY ch.CrimeHeadName
ORDER BY avg_days DESC;

questions.question: Which cases have been open for more than a year with no chargesheet?
questions.question_kn: ಒಂದು ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕಾಲ ಬಾಕಿ ಇರುವ ಪ್ರಕರಣಗಳು ಯಾವುವು?
questions.sql:
SELECT cm.CrimeNo, cm.CrimeRegisteredDate
FROM CaseMaster cm
LEFT JOIN ChargesheetDetails cs ON cs.CaseMasterID = cm.CaseMasterID
WHERE cs.CaseMasterID IS NULL
  AND julianday(:as_of) - julianday(cm.CrimeRegisteredDate) > 365
ORDER BY cm.CrimeRegisteredDate;

questions.question: Which offenders have the highest share of cases ending in a chargesheet?
questions.sql:
SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cs.CaseMasterID) * 1.0
     / COUNT(DISTINCT ri.CaseMasterID) AS chargesheet_share,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ri.CaseMasterID) AS cases
FROM resolved_identity ri
LEFT JOIN ChargesheetDetails cs ON cs.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ri.CaseMasterID) >= 3
ORDER BY chargesheet_share DESC;

questions.question: How many cases is each investigating officer carrying?
questions.question_kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ತನಿಖಾಧಿಕಾರಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಪ್ರಕರಣ ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾರೆ?
questions.sql:
SELECT e.EmployeeName, COUNT(*) AS cases
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeID = cm.IOEmployeeID
GROUP BY e.EmployeeName
ORDER BY cases DESC;

questions.question: Who is the investigating officer on this case?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಪ್ರಕರಣದ ತನಿಖಾಧಿಕಾರಿ ಯಾರು?
questions.sql:
SELECT e.EmployeeName, e.DesignationID
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeID = cm.IOEmployeeID
WHERE cm.CaseMasterID = :case_id;

questions.question: Which officers have handled cases involving the same repeat offender?
questions.sql:
SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cm.IOEmployeeID) AS officers,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ri.CaseMasterID) AS cases
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cm.IOEmployeeID) > 1
ORDER BY officers DESC;

questions.question: How many officers are posted at this station?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಠಾಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಅಧಿಕಾರಿಗಳಿದ್ದಾರೆ?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS officers
FROM Employee e
JOIN Unit u ON u.UnitID = e.UnitID
WHERE u.UnitName = :station;

questions.question: Is caseload per officer even across the district?
questions.sql:
SELECT u.UnitName,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cm.CaseMasterID) AS cases,
       COUNT(DISTINCT e.EmployeeID) AS officers,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cm.CaseMasterID) * 1.0
     / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT e.EmployeeID), 0) AS load_per_officer
FROM Unit u
LEFT JOIN CaseMaster cm ON cm.UnitID = u.UnitID
LEFT JOIN Employee e    ON e.UnitID  = u.UnitID
WHERE u.DistrictID = :district_id
GROUP BY u.UnitName
ORDER BY load_per_officer DESC;

questions.question: Which sections were applied in this case?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಪ್ರಕರಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವ ಸೆಕ್ಷನ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಅನ್ವಯಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ?
questions.sql:
SELECT a.ActAbbr, s.SectionNo, s.SectionDesc
FROM ActSectionAssociation asa
JOIN Act a     ON a.ActID     = asa.ActID
JOIN Section s ON s.SectionID = asa.SectionID
WHERE asa.CaseMasterID = :case_id;

questions.question: Which section is most frequently applied statewide?
questions.sql:
SELECT s.SectionNo, s.SectionDesc, COUNT(*) AS uses
FROM ActSectionAssociation asa
JOIN Section s ON s.SectionID = asa.SectionID
GROUP BY s.SectionNo, s.SectionDesc
ORDER BY uses DESC
LIMIT 20;

questions.question: Which sections most often appear together on one FIR?
questions.sql:
SELECT sa.SectionNo AS section_a, sb.SectionNo AS section_b,
       COUNT(*) AS co_occurrences
FROM ActSectionAssociation a
JOIN ActSectionAssociation b ON b.CaseMasterID = a.CaseMasterID
                            AND b.SectionID > a.SectionID
JOIN Section sa ON sa.SectionID = a.SectionID
JOIN Section sb ON sb.SectionID = b.SectionID
GROUP BY section_a, section_b
ORDER BY co_occurrences DESC
LIMIT 20;

questions.question: Which offenders have been booked under this section more than once?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಸೆಕ್ಷನ್ ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಬಾರಿ ಪ್ರಕರಣ ದಾಖಲಾದವರು ಯಾರು?
questions.sql:
SELECT ri.ResolvedIdentityID, COUNT(DISTINCT ri.CaseMasterID) AS cases
FROM resolved_identity ri
JOIN ActSectionAssociation asa ON asa.CaseMasterID = ri.CaseMasterID
JOIN Section s ON s.SectionID = asa.SectionID
WHERE s.SectionNo = :section
GROUP BY ri.ResolvedIdentityID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ri.CaseMasterID) > 1
ORDER BY cases DESC;

questions.question: How many cases were registered under this section in this district?
questions.question_kn: ಈ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ಸೆಕ್ಷನ್ ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಪ್ರಕರಣ ದಾಖಲಾಗಿವೆ?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cm.CaseMasterID) AS cases
FROM CaseMaster cm
JOIN ActSectionAssociation asa ON asa.CaseMasterID = cm.CaseMasterID
JOIN Section s ON s.SectionID = asa.SectionID
WHERE s.SectionNo = :section
  AND cm.DistrictID = :district_id;
